title: Speak, O Lord
lyrics_original: Speak, O Lord, as we come to You
To receive the food of Your Holy Word.
Take Your Truth, plant it deep in us;
Shape and fashion us in Your likeness;
That the light of Christ might be seen today
In our acts of love and our deeds of faith.
Speak O Lord, and fulfill in us
All your purposes for your glory.
Teach us Lord, full obedience
Holy reverence, true humility.
Test our thoughts and our attitudes
In the radiance of Your purity.
Cause our faith to rise, cause our eyes to see
Your majestic love and authority.
Words of power that can never fail;
Let their truth prevail over unbelief.
Speak O Lord, and renew our minds;
Help us grasp the heights of Your plans for us
Truths unchanged from the dawn of time,
That will echo down through eternity.
And by grace we'll stand on Your promises;
And by faith we'll walk as You walk with us.
Speak, O Lord, till your church is built,
And the earth is filled with your glory.

bible_verses.english: Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness, that the man of God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.
Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.

If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you. “By this my Father is glorified, that you bear much fruit; and so you will be my disciples.

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, speak to my heart today through Your Holy Word. Plant Your truth deep within me and soften my spirit to receive Your guidance and grace. Shape my thoughts, attitudes, and actions so that the light of Christ shines clearly through everything I do. Fulfill Your good purposes in me today, for Your glory alone. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Heavenly Father, speak to my heart today through Your Holy Word. Plant Your truth deep within me and soften my spirit to receive Your guidance and grace. devotional.reflection_english: "Speak, O Lord" invites us to open our hearts like fertile soil, ready to receive the life-giving nourishment of God's Word. As we listen, Scripture does more than inform us—it reshapes our desires, tests our thoughts, and molds us into the image of Jesus. When His truth takes root within us, our daily lives naturally radiate Christ's love and faith to the world around us. Today, let us quiet our minds and ask the Holy Spirit to transform us through His truth.
